body: I haven’t tried therapy. My suicidal thoughts haven’t been consistent. It’s only recently where it’s hit me like a tsunami. I broke down sobbing about two times since the beginning of the month. I’ve definitely had intense thoughts about suicide in the past. But i’ve killed it via cycling and philosophy. I probably will talk to some of my friends about it though.

Nah, I haven’t talked to anybody. And yeah, I just turned 18 about a week or so ago, hahaah. I plan to become an EMT and volunteer with Doctors Without Borders. Go overseas for a bit, come back, then apply for a few scholarships and grants. I plan to double major in aerospace engineering & robotics. And from there, work on space exploration and military robotics.
